notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that was loading the GPU 100% by adding fps locking, 
Now the game defaults to 60fps, in game settings you can unlock FPS. (VSync). 
Compressed some game textures for less memory consumption.
Fixed minor bugs.

It is recommended to restart Steam and perform a clean install of the game.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[b]And so, the first and not a big update.[/b]


[list]
[*] Added Russian localization
[*] Removed unnecessary doors and bushes on the first location
[*] Removed unnecessary stones, plants and other debris.
[*] Reduced the size of the corridor on the first location
[*] Fixed models collision
[*] Added missing light sources.
[*] Disabled shadows to reduce load in some locations
[*] Fixed global lighting on the 1st location
[*] Changed monster animation for smoother movement
[/list]

notes.title: New engine.
notes.content:
Fixed all problems.
In the future, the game will be updated, new locations will be added.
Upscale almost all vanilla textures, up to 4k.
Reducing the loading screen time.
And much, much more.
